caption: The drawing depicts a metallic jug or pitcher centered on a plain, beige background. The jug is rendered in shades of gray and black, indicating a metal texture with visible areas of light and shadow, as well as surface irregularities, highlighting its worn appearance. The jug has a cylindrical neck, a spout, and a single, rounded handle attached to its side. The body of the jug is conical and appears to be composed of two main sections, with a seam running horizontally approximately at its middle, suggesting it may have been constructed from separate pieces. The object is centrally placed, and the rest of the background remains empty except for a small printed or stamped text on the right side that appears to be the artist's name or a signature.
title: Petticoat Peg Lamp
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
